# ajew.org — The Largest Online Breslov Torah Library

> ajew.org is a free, comprehensive Jewish Torah library with 230+ sacred texts in Hebrew and English, focusing on the teachings of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov.

## Key Content

### Breslov Core Texts (Hebrew + English)
- Likutay Moharan: 411 Torahs — /reader/likutay-moharan/1/1
- Likutay Halachos: 593 sections — /reader/likutay-halachos/1/1  
- Sichos HaRan: 309 conversations — /reader/sichos-haran/1/1
- Sipurey Maasiyos: 13 stories — /reader/sipurey-maasiyos/1/1
- Sefer HaMidos: 108 topics — /reader/sefer-hamidos/1/1
- Likutay Tefilos: 211 prayers — /reader/likutay-tefilos/1/1
- Alim LiTrufa: 477 letters — /reader/alim-litrufa/2/2
- Kitzur Likutay Moharan: 289 summaries — /reader/kitzur-likutay-moharan/1/1
- Chayay Moharan: 12 chapters — /reader/chayey-moharan/1/1
- Shivchay HaRan: 64 sections — /reader/shivchay-haran/1/1
- Meshivas Nefesh: 183 sections — /reader/meshivas-nefesh/1/1
- Hashtatfchus HaNefesh: 130 sections — /reader/hashtatfchus-hanefesh/1/1
- Yisroel Saba: 93 chapters — /reader/yisroel-saba/1/1
- Michtevay Shmuel: 196 letters — /reader/michtevay-shmuel/1/1

### Talmud Bavli (Hebrew)
- Complete Babylonian Talmud — 37 tractates

### Mishna (Hebrew)
- Complete Mishna — 63 tractates

### Tanach (Hebrew)
- Complete Hebrew Bible

### Rambam (Hebrew)
- Mishneh Torah — 14 books

### Zohar (Hebrew)
- Complete Zohar — 7 volumes

### Ramchal (Hebrew + English)
- Mesillas Yesharim — /reader/ramchal-mesillas-yesharim/1/1
- Derech Hashem — /reader/ramchal-derech-hashem/1/1
- Da'as Tevunos — /reader/ramchal-daas-tevunos/1/1
- Klach Pitchei Chochma — /reader/ramchal-klach-pitchei-chochma/1/1

## Features
- Bilingual reader (Hebrew/English side-by-side)
- Advanced search across 22,000+ pages
- Torah GPS: 51 spiritual topics
- Daily Study (Chok Breslov)
- Healing Words: curated spiritual journeys
- Tikkun HaKlali with Chatzos timer
- Chain of Light: cross-reference explorer
- Torah Trivia game
- RSS feed: /rss.xml
- Sitemap: /sitemap-index.xml

## API
- Search: /api/search?q=your+query&type=google
- RSS: /rss.xml
